children: U.S. stocks moved lower on Tuesday morning as investors weighed President Donald Trump's comments about a potential agreement with Iran against ongoing geopolitical risks,
The S&P 500 slipped 0.2%, while the Dow Jones Industrial Average declined 0.3%. The Nasdaq Composite fell 0.1%, with the major indexes ending the session slightly lower.

Speaking at the United Nations, Trump said the United States could eventually reach an agreement with Iran. He also indicated that Tehran may be more willing to reach a deal after the Nov. 3 U.S. midterm elections. Reuters separately reported that Trump said talks between the two countries were continuing.

Investors were also preparing for fresh economic data. The September flash Composite Purchasing Managers' Index and the Atlanta Federal Reserve's Business Inflation Expectations survey were due later, while markets continued to assess the outlook for interest rates and inflation.

title: U.S. Stocks Falls as Trump Raises Hopes for Iran Deal After Midterms
